elements.title: Stenaelurillus darwini (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: Andreas von Velven (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Mindaugas bribed Andreas von Velven with gifts and agreed to be baptized to stop the Livonian Order's invasion of Lithuania?
